reasoning.overall: Tight, low-to-medium-event semi-final first leg at the Metropolitano. Arteta has confirmed Kai Havertz is out for the first leg, while Eze, Saka and Calafiori are available; Timber and Merino remain unavailable. Atleti are without Barrios and Gimenez, with Lookman and Hancko doubtful, but Alvarez should start. Arsenal hammered Atleti 4-0 in October at the Emirates with Gabriel, Martinelli and a Gyokeres brace, but at the Calderon/Metropolitano Atletico have never lost to an English side in a CL knockout match (P6 W3 D3). This Atleti are far less defensively robust, conceding 26 in 14 CL games and BTTS has hit in 8 of last 10 Atleti games, suggesting goals are likely. Bookmakers price this near a coin-flip with a marginal Arsenal lean and a strong draw chance.
